node.title: W3 parametric row-scope router
node.statement: The challenge defines an admissible parametric family rather than a named finite official-row registry. The proved descriptor computes exact q, n, k, and B*=floor(q/2^128) for every admissible input (p,e,s,rho). This made W3 and its scope exactly testable. The explicit fiber-layout row refutes only an unsafe-cell extension, not W3's literal safe-side claim. Because the repaired prize path no longer consumes W3, no finite official-row sweep or certificate campaign remains on that path.
